description: This PHP source file defines the AWS SDK client for the Amazon CodeCatalyst service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, and listing resources related to CodeCatalyst. The class extends AwsClient and is used to facilitate interactions with the CodeCatalyst API.

classes.name: CodeCatalystClient
classes.description: AWS SDK client class for Amazon CodeCatalyst, providing methods to interact with the service API.

methods.name: createAccessToken
methods.description: Creates an access token for CodeCatalyst.

methods.description: Asynchronously creates an access token for CodeCatalyst.

methods.description: Creates a new development environment in CodeCatalyst.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project in CodeCatalyst.
